 Dated this the 9th day of March, 2015
 Judgment

The petitioner has approached this Court with the following prayers:
a. Call for the records of the case and to quash the condition being stipulated by the 3rd respondent that the raw betel nuts should obtain NOC from 2nd respondent before being permitted to be cleared for home consumption.
b. To declare that raw betel nuts being imported by the petitioner do not constitute food or articles of food and also that the provisions of FSS Act are not applicable to such goods.
c. To direct the respondents to permit release the consignments being imported by the petitioner under Exts.P1, P2 and P3 and other similar goods without subjecting it to tests under FSS Act. d.
To grant the costs of these proceedings to the petitioner.

When the matter came up for consideration before this Court the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the issue is squarely covered by the judgment of this Court dated 15.10.2014 in W.P.(C) No.26217 of 2013 and connected cases.
It is conceded from the part of the concerned respondents as well.

Hence this writ petition is also disposed of, in terms of the judgment dated 15.10.2014 in W.P.(C)
No.26217 of 2013 and connected cases.

Sd/-
P.R.RAMACHANDRA MENON, JUDGE.
